name: podcast-studio
description: Podcast & Gaming Studio — Professional macOS App
author: Podcast Studio

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently --kill-other-on-fail "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run electron:compile && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.js
scripts.electron:build:unsigned: npm run build && npm run electron:compile && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.config.js
